metadata.description: Arcgram — interactive node-and-edge diagrams as a single standalone HTML file, for any AI agent.

plugins.name: arcgram
plugins.description: Generate an interactive node-and-edge diagram as a single standalone HTML file (pan, zoom, hover tooltips, color-coded categories, orthogonal edge routing) — no build step, no npm, no CDN, no runtime. Bundles the Arcgram authoring skill plus Checkpoint / Reconcile / Validate self-checks. Agent-neutral.
